description_en: Invokes a published Mobile Planner Agent using OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions messages to initiate a conversation or node planning, and returns text, model-provided reasoning content, and structured tool calling via SSE. Supports multi-turn sessions and model-supported image input. Business tools are executed by the caller
description_zh: 调用已发布的 Mobile Planner Agent，使用 OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions 消息发起对话或任务规划，以 SSE 返回文本、模型提供的思考内容及结构化工具调用。支持多轮会话和模型支持的图片输入；业务工具由调用方执行
name: PaChatCompletionStream

parameters.help_en: The Agent instance access key used for QICloud Customer API authentication
parameters.help_zh: Agent 实例访问密钥，用于 QICloud Customer 接口鉴权
parameters.name: x_qi_agent_api_key

parameters.help_en: The published Mobile Planner Agent instance ID. Must correspond to the X-QI-Agent-Api-Key
parameters.help_zh: 已发布的 Mobile Planner Agent 实例 ID，必须与 X-QI-Agent-Api-Key 对应
parameters.name: x_qi_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The optional session identifier. Can be omitted for the first turn, in which case the server generates one. Pass it back in subsequent turns to continue the Mobile Planner Agent session
parameters.help_zh: 可选会话标识。首轮可省略，由服务端生成；后续轮次传回以续接 Mobile Planner Agent 会话
parameters.name: x_qi_session_id

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of token IDs allowed for generation
parameters.help_zh: 允许生成的 Token ID 白名单
parameters.name: allowed_token_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of words or strings prohibited from generation
parameters.help_zh: 禁止生成的词或字符串列表
parameters.name: bad_words

fields.help_en: Controls whether the model generates reasoning_content through chat_template_kwargs. This value is passed to the model used by the Mobile Planner Agent
fields.help_zh: 通过 chat_template_kwargs 控制模型是否生成 reasoning_content；该值会传给 Mobile Planner Agent 使用的模型
fields.name: enable_thinking

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the model preserves and reuses existing reasoning content in subsequent turns. Passed through as-is per vLLM/Qwen chat_template_kwargs
fields.help_zh: 是否让模型在续轮中保留并复用已有思考内容；按 vLLM/Qwen chat_template_kwargs 原样透传
fields.name: preserve_thinking

parameters.help_en: The vLLM/OpenAI-Compatible template parameter object. Request values are merged with model defaults, with request keys taking precedence, and passed to the model as-is
parameters.help_zh: vLLM/OpenAI-Compatible 模板参数对象。请求值与模型默认值合并，请求同名键优先，并原样传给模型
parameters.name: chat_template_kwargs

parameters.help_en: The frequency penalty parameter passed through to the Mobile Planner Agent model
parameters.help_zh: 频率惩罚参数，透传给 Mobile Planner Agent 模型
parameters.name: frequency_penalty

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to ignore EOS and continue generation
parameters.help_zh: 是否忽略 EOS 并继续生成
parameters.name: ignore_eos

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to request reasoning content from the upstream. The actual capability depends on the model
parameters.help_zh: 是否要求上游返回推理内容；具体能力取决于模型
parameters.name: include_reasoning

parameters.help_en: A model-compatible parameter with the JSON field name logprobs. Whether it is accepted and takes effect depends on the model used by the instance. The current Agent response does not provide token log probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 logprobs。是否接受及生效取决于实例所用模型；当前 Agent 响应不提供 Token 对数概率明细
parameters.name: logprobs

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of completion tokens. Must be greater than 0 if provided, and is passed as an OpenAI-compatible model parameter
parameters.help_zh: 最大补全 Token 数，提供时必须大于 0，并作为 OpenAI 兼容模型参数传入
parameters.name: max_completion_tokens

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible maximum number of generated tokens. Must be greater than 0 if provided
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容最大生成 Token 数，提供时必须大于 0
parameters.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The image URL. Remote images must use HTTPS. Base64 Data URLs are also accepted
fields.help_zh: 图片地址。远程图片必须使用 HTTPS；也可传 Base64 Data URL
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The image reference when type=image_url. Supports HTTPS URLs or data:image/...;base64,... format
fields.help_zh: type=image_url 时的图片引用；支持 HTTPS URL 或 data:image/...;base64,
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en: The non-empty text when type=text
fields.help_zh: type=text 时的非空文本
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The content part type. Mobile Planner Agent user messages support text or image_url
fields.help_zh: 内容分片类型。Mobile Planner Agent user 消息支持 text 或 image_url
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The message content. Mobile Planner Agent supports text and multimodal content. Image URLs or base64 Data URLs are passed through to the Mobile Planner Agent model if it supports multimodal input
fields.help_zh: 消息内容。Mobile Planner Agent 支持文本及多模态内容；图片 URL 或 base64 Data URL 会通传到支持多模态的 Mobile Planner Agent 模型
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The message role: user, assistant, tool, system, or developer. system/developer is used for optional per-turn text instruction overrides. If omitted, the instructions from the instance configuration are used. Tool results use tool and are associated with tool_call_id
fields.help_zh: 消息角色：user、assistant、tool、system 或 developer。system/developer 用于本轮可选文本指令覆盖；省略时使用实例配置中的指令。工具结果使用 tool 并关联 tool_call_id
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: Required when role=tool. Must match an id from the preceding assistant.tool_calls
fields.help_zh: role=tool 时必填，必须匹配此前 assistant.tool_calls 中的 id
fields.name: tool_call_id

fields.help_en: The JSON object string of function arguments
fields.help_zh: 函数参数的 JSON 对象字符串
fields.name: arguments

fields.help_en: The name of the function to call
fields.help_zh: 要调用的函数名
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The function information of a historical tool invocation entry, including name and arguments as a JSON character string. Retain the actual returned values in subsequent turns
fields.help_zh: 历史工具调用的函数信息，包含 name 及 JSON 字符串形式的 arguments；续轮应保留实际返回值
fields.name: function

fields.help_en: The tool invocation ID. Subsequent tool messages reference this through tool_call_id
fields.help_zh: 工具调用 ID；后续 tool 消息通过 tool_call_id 引用
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The tool invocation type. Currently fixed as function
fields.help_zh: 工具调用类型，当前固定为 function
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of function invocation entries that can be carried when role=assistant. Used for multi-turn tool invocation continuation
fields.help_zh: role=assistant 时可携带的函数调用列表；用于多轮工具调用续接
fields.name: tool_calls

parameters.help_en: The list of conversation messages. The first call can submit one turn or an existing multi-turn conversation. When continuing with an existing session ID, retain the complete and unmodified historical message prefix and append the current turn messages. Tool results are associated through role=tool and the corresponding tool_call_id
parameters.help_zh: 对话消息列表。首次调用可提交一轮或已有多轮对话；携带已有会话 ID 续接时，保留完整且未改动的历史消息前缀，并追加本轮消息。工具结果通过 role=tool 和对应的 tool_call_id 关联
parameters.name: messages

parameters.help_en: The vLLM Min-P sampling parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM Min-P 采样参数
parameters.name: min_p

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of tokens to generate
parameters.help_zh: 最少生成 Token 数
parameters.name: min_tokens

fields.help_en: Example: the maximum number of dynamic image patches allowed by the vision model
fields.help_zh: 示例：视觉模型允许的最大动态图像 patch 数
fields.name: max_dynamic_patch

parameters.help_en: The multimodal preprocessor parameters passed through to vLLM as-is by key
parameters.help_zh: 多模态预处理器参数，按键原样透传给 vLLM
parameters.name: mm_processor_kwargs

parameters.help_en: Reserved for OpenAI client compatibility. Ignored during routing. The actual model is determined by the published instance configuration. The model field in the response is always an empty string
parameters.help_zh: 为 OpenAI 客户端兼容保留；路由时忽略，实际模型由实例已发布配置决定，响应 model 固定为空字符串
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to 1. Whether the model accepts this parameter depends on the model. The current Mobile Planner Agent response does not return multiple candidate results. Do not use this parameter for multiple-candidate responses
parameters.help_zh: 建议设为 1。该参数是否被模型接受取决于模型；当前 Mobile Planner Agent 响应不会透出多个候选结果，请勿按多候选返回使用
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the model is allowed to generate multiple tool calling requests in parallel. The model invokes tools concurrently when this parameter is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许模型并行生成多个工具调用
parameters.name: parallel_tool_calls

parameters.help_en: The presence penalty parameter, passed through to the Mobile Planner Agent model
parameters.help_zh: 存在惩罚参数，透传给 Mobile Planner Agent 模型
parameters.name: presence_penalty

parameters.help_en: A model compatibility parameter. The JSON field is prompt_logprobs. Whether the model accepts this parameter depends on the model. The current Agent response does not return probability details for input tokens
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 prompt_logprobs。是否接受取决于模型；当前 Agent 响应不返回输入 Token 概率明细
parameters.name: prompt_logprobs

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible reasoning effort level, such as low, medium, or high
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容推理强度，例如 low、medium、high
parameters.name: reasoning_effort

parameters.help_en: The vLLM repetition penalty parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 重复惩罚参数
parameters.name: repetition_penalty

fields.help_en: The response format type, such as text, json_object, or json_schema
fields.help_zh: 响应格式类型，例如 text、json_object 或 json_schema
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The structured response format, such as json_object or json_schema
parameters.help_zh: 结构化响应格式，例如 json_object 或 json_schema
parameters.name: response_format

parameters.help_en: The random seed
parameters.help_zh: 随机种子
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip special tokens
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过特殊 Token
parameters.name: skip_special_tokens

parameters.help_en: The stop sequences. Compatible with a single string or an array of strings. This field is displayed in array format
parameters.help_zh: 停止序列。兼容单个字符串或字符串数组；此处展示数组形式
parameters.name: stop

parameters.help_en: The vLLM stop token ID list
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 停止 Token ID 列表
parameters.name: stop_token_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use SSE streaming responses. This parameter must be set to true for this operation
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用 SSE 流式响应。本接口必须传 true
parameters.name: stream

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to output a usage statistics chunk before data:[DONE]
fields.help_zh: 是否在 data:[DONE] 之前输出 usage 统计块
fields.name: include_usage

parameters.help_en: The OpenAI-compatible streaming options
parameters.help_zh: OpenAI 兼容流式选项
parameters.name: stream_options

fields.help_en: The set of allowed enumeration text values
fields.help_zh: 允许的枚举文本集合
fields.name: choice

parameters.help_en: The vLLM structured output constraints
parameters.help_zh: vLLM 结构化输出约束
parameters.name: structured_outputs

parameters.help_en: The sampling temperature. Passed as an OpenAI-compatible model parameter to override the model default value
parameters.help_zh: 采样温度；作为 OpenAI 兼容模型参数传入，覆盖模型默认值
parameters.name: temperature

parameters.help_en: The tool choice strategy. Valid values: auto, none, required, or a named selection supported by the model
parameters.help_zh: 工具选择策略，支持 auto、none、required 或模型支持的命名选择
parameters.name: tool_choice

fields.help_en: The description of the function purpose. The model uses this to determine when to call the tool
fields.help_zh: 函数用途说明，供模型判断何时调用该工具
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The function name. This parameter is required. Used to match assistant.tool_calls with subsequent tool results
fields.help_zh: 函数名，必须非空；用于匹配 assistant.tool_calls 与后续 tool 结果
fields.name: name

fields.example: 要查询天气的城市名称
fields.help_en: The sample parameter description
fields.help_zh: 示例参数说明
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The JSON Schema type of the sample city field
fields.help_zh: 示例 city 字段的 JSON Schema 类型
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The Schema for the sample business parameter city. The actual fields are determined by the caller's tool definition
fields.help_zh: 示例业务参数 city 的 Schema。实际字段由调用方工具定义决定
fields.name: city

fields.help_en: The property definitions of the JSON Schema
fields.help_zh: JSON Schema 的属性定义
fields.name: properties

fields.help_en: The array of required field names in the JSON Schema
fields.help_zh: JSON Schema 必填字段名称数组
fields.name: required

fields.help_en: The root Schema type of the function parameters. Typically set to object
fields.help_zh: 函数 parameters 根 Schema 类型，通常为 object
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The JSON Schema for function parameters, passed to the model as raw JSON. If not provided, an empty object Schema is used
fields.help_zh: 函数参数 JSON Schema，按原始 JSON 传给模型；未提供时使用空对象 Schema
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the model must strictly follow the function parameter JSON Schema
fields.help_zh: 是否要求模型严格遵循函数参数 JSON Schema
fields.name: strict

fields.help_en: The function tool definition, including the name, description, and JSON Schema parameters
fields.help_zh: 函数工具定义，包含名称、描述与 JSON Schema 参数
fields.name: function

fields.help_en: The tool type. This parameter must be set to function
fields.help_zh: 工具类型，当前必须为 function
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The array of function tool definitions available for this request. Mobile Planner Agent registers each named function in the runtime Toolkit and returns tool_calls in the streaming response
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求可用的函数工具定义数组。Mobile Planner Agent 会将每个命名函数注册到运行时 Toolkit，并流式返回 tool_calls
parameters.name: tools

parameters.help_en: The vLLM Top-K sampling parameter
parameters.help_zh: vLLM Top-K 采样参数
parameters.name: topk

parameters.help_en: A model compatibility parameter. The JSON field is top_logprobs. Used for models that support this feature. The current Agent response does not provide candidate token probability details
parameters.help_zh: 模型兼容参数，JSON 字段为 top_logprobs。用于支持该功能的模型；当前 Agent 响应不提供候选 Token 概率明细
parameters.name: top_logprobs

parameters.help_en: Top-P sampling parameter. Passed as an OpenAI-compatible model parameter to override the model default value
parameters.help_zh: Top-P 采样参数；作为 OpenAI 兼容模型参数传入，覆盖模型默认值
parameters.name: topp

schema.description_en: The SSE streaming response metadata. Business data is returned continuously as chat.completion.chunk events and ends with data:[DONE]. For complete field descriptions, see the response elements supplementary description
schema.description_zh: SSE 流式响应元数据。业务数据按 chat.completion.chunk 事件连续返回，最终以 data:[DONE] 结束；完整字段说明见返回参数补充说明

requestId.description_en: The request identity generated by the POP gateway for gateway Tracing Analysis. The Agent execute request ID is based on qi_request_id in the SSE body
requestId.description_zh: Id of the request由 POP 网关生成的请求标识，用于网关链路追踪；Agent 执行请求 ID 以 SSE 正文中的 qi_request_id 为准

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The Mobile Planner Agent call request body. Uses the JSON field format of OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions. The messages field is required and stream must be set to true. The model is determined by the instance configuration
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: Mobile Planner Agent 调用请求体。使用 OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions 的 JSON 字段格式；messages 必填，stream 设为 true。模型由实例配置决定
v1_body_parameters.name: body
